invariants.rationale: The metaClient parameter should be non-null at method entry to operate on the table metadata.
The columnsToIndex list should be non-null to update columns to index.
All strings in columnsToIndex should be non-null to specify valid column names.
columnsToIndex should not be empty to have effect in updating index columns.
Table name from metaClient should be non-null as a basic consistency invariant.
